name: CIFAR-10
description: CIFAR-10 is a widely used dataset in machine learning, consisting of 60,000 32x32 color images in 10 classes, with 50,000 training images and 10,000 validation images.
citeAs: Krizhevsky, A., Nair, V., & Hinton, G. (2009). CIFAR-10 (Canadian Institute for Advanced Research).

rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataCollection: The dataset consists of 32x32 color images labeled into 10 classes.
rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is used to facilitate research in machine learning, particularly in training neural networks and evaluating training speed and performance.
